scope: '## D1 — node-level telemetry' (overhead table, null-control line, stage-table headings, stage tables d1f_rr_s1, d1f_rr_s2, anf_rr_s1, anf_rr_s2, anf_li_t1, anf_li_t2 incl. occupancy, and the GIL-share-by-stage table inside the section) plus the 'D1 (telemetry)' row of '## Verdicts'
raw_files_used: perdoc_*.jsonl, leg_*.json (window.t0_ns/t1_ns, p0.session.boot_id/same_session) and stamp_probe.jsonl in d1f_rr_{s1,u1,s2,u2}, anf_rr_{u1,u2,s1,s2}, anf_li_{u1,u2,t1,t2}; pyspy_gil_rr_*.txt in h2f_c32_a, h2f_c32_b (GIL table attempt only)
method_notes: Span docs/s = ok rows / ((max completion_ns - min submit_ns)/1e9) over all rows; spread, overhead, threshold as defined.

RocketRide stages: measured docs = perdoc docs whose 3 stamp records all carry a stage (27 warm-up docs in stamp_probe are not in perdoc and are excluded); run total = sum(completion-submit) over those docs.
LlamaIndex stages: the 95 rows carrying svc_timing_ms (the 96th is ok=false, parse_failed); run total = sum(completion-submit) over those 95.
Metric set: population sd, true median, nearest-rank p90/p95/p99 (rank ceil(q*n)).

Occupancy (definition only partly given): reconstructed as the time-weighted distribution of the number of documents inside the stage interval over [leg window t0_ns, t1_ns]; RocketRide intervals admission [submit, open], parse_bracket [open, after_parse.last_t], split [.., after_split.last_t], embed [.., after_embed.last_t], return [.., completion]; LlamaIndex intervals from svc_timing_ms.t0_wall + extract, + split, + embed. p50/p95 = smallest count whose cumulative time share >= q. All 108 occupancy figures reproduce under this reconstruction.

mismatches.note: Digit transposition: recomputed span docs/s for d1f_rr_s1 is 2.928650 (382 ok rows over the leg's first-submit-to-last-completion span). The row's own overhead (-0.06%) and threshold (0.82%) are consistent with 2.9287, not 2.9827: with 2.9827 the instrumented mean would be 2.9509, the overhead -0.98% and the instrumented spread 2.16%.

unverifiable.reason: Categorisation of py-spy stacks into embed / split / engine glue / response node / other is not defined in the stated methodology, so these 10 figures cannot be recomputed as specified. Informational only: sample totals 2,986 (h2f_c32_a) and 3,024 (h2f_c32_b); an inferred rule (any frame on the stack in embedding code [nodes/embedding_transformer, ai/common/models/transformers, sentence_transformers, torch, transformers] -> embed; else langchain/preprocessor -> split; else nodes/response -> response) reproduces embed 62.4%/59.7%, split 1.8%/2.4%, response 0.5%/0.5%; the engine-glue vs other split depends on how transport frames under ai/modules/data/data_conn.py are assigned (e.g. glue excluding stacks through rocketride/core/transport_websocket.send gives 5.1% / 5.4% vs reported 5.1% / 5.3%; other variants give 5.0% / 5.1%), so no rule could be confirmed.
